title: Accepting a Change in Health
paragraphs: Setelah cedera membatasi olahraga yang dapat ia lakukan, Rafi merasa frustrasi selama berbulan-bulan. Ia sulit menerima bahwa tubuhnya telah berubah. Seorang kerabat yang lebih tua berkata bahwa menerima keadaan bukan berarti menyerah. Itu berarti menyesuaikan rencana sambil tetap percaya kepada Allah dalam perubahan yang sulit.

Perlahan, Rafi mencoba kegiatan yang sesuai dengan keterbatasan barunya. Ia mendapati beberapa kegiatan itu lebih menyenangkan dari dugaannya. Setahun kemudian, Rafi masih merindukan beberapa kegiatan lamanya, tetapi ia telah membangun rutinitas aktif yang berbeda. Ia belajar melangkah dengan sabar dan tawakal.
answerKey: After an injury limited the sports he could play, Rafi felt frustrated for many months. He found it hard to accept that his body had changed. An older relative told him that acceptance did not mean giving up. It meant adjusting his plans while trusting Allah through a difficult change. Slowly, Rafi tried activities that suited his new limits. He found that he enjoyed some of them more than he expected. A year later, Rafi still missed some old activities, but he had built a different active routine. He learned to move forward with patience and trust.
